hints.title: Full Character Extent
hints.text: Any valid substring containing character c must contain all occurrences of character c.

hints.title: Interval Expansion
hints.text: Record first and last occurrences of each character. For each starting character, expand its interval until all characters within it are completely encompassed.

hints.title: Greedy Interval Selection
hints.text: Sort all valid expanded intervals by their ending indices. Greedily pick non-overlapping intervals with earliest end.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking arbitrary substring combinations is combinatorial.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: There are at most 26 valid minimal intervals, expanding each takes O(N), and greedy interval scheduling takes O(26 log 26).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate formalizes valid substrings as self-contained intervals and applies earliest-deadline interval scheduling.
complexity.notes: Maximizes number of substrings first, then minimizes total length.

solutions.approach: Character interval expansion followed by greedy interval scheduling
